[RULES]
G1 Extract every entity of the supplied types from a research abstract. Return exact spans from the text.

[TYPE] METHOD
[DESCRIPTION] A named algorithm, model architecture or technique.
M1 Models used as baselines are METHOD too ("an LSTM baseline", "compared with T5").

[TYPE] DATASET
[DESCRIPTION] A named dataset or benchmark.

[TYPE] METRIC
[DESCRIPTION] An evaluation metric, such as accuracy, F1 or BLEU.

[TYPE] TASK
[DESCRIPTION] The problem being solved, such as question answering or machine translation.

[TYPE] NOT_AN_ENTITY
NE1 Hardware and compute, such as "4 TPUs", "a single A100" or "16 GB of memory".

[RULES]
G2 Every evaluation measure is METRIC, never TASK, even when it sounds like a task ("answer accuracy", "span recall"). This overrides everything above.
